Investors wipe $2.5 trillion off Nasdaq as blue tsunami prompts AI fears | Reuters
noticias.resumo:
Nov 5 (Reuters) - Tech-led Nasdaq notched its deepest one-day drop since ‘Liberation Day’ in April 2025, wiping ​out trillions in market value on fears of more AI scrutiny, particularly on data center construction, after Democrats won big in US midterm elections. 

The Nasdaq Composite fell 5. 5% on ‌investor fears that the Democratic Party's sweeping midterm victory could stall AI infrastructure expansion and force a reckoning for smaller firms whose capacity to raise funds has already been limited by higher interest rates and tighter financial conditions.
